Definition: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fix ("peg"), i.e. (specially) to set up (a tent):--pitch.
BiblicalUsage: Pegnumi means to pitch, to set up — here, the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched and not man. Christ ministers in the sanctuary no human hands raised.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure that what God pitches, no man can strike: my hope stands in a tabernacle built by the Lord Himself.
